message: I've had my fair share of unexpected blackouts, and let me tell you, there’s nothing quite like your phone dying just when you need it most. It’s a good reminder that being prepared can really make a difference. I checked out this resource from the Red Cross that offers some practical tips on how to handle power outages. Remember, having a plan in place can keep things running smoothly, even when the lights go out! What’s your favorite blackout hack?
